2. Fix the problem that the transformed monster cannot be attacked by random target cards in the first round;

4. Fix the problem that the magic weapon of the Demon Subduing Umbrella does not trigger;

notes.title: [New difficulty version] Constantly challenge yourself and exceed the limit
notes.content:
1、 There are 15 new difficulty versions, which are divided into three modes: human model, Shura model and purgatory model. Each mode has 5 difficulties;

The initial difficulty will be from fixed BOSS to the subsequent three-in-one BOSS, and the event income will be gradually reduced. We prefer to provide players with a smooth experience from simple to difficult, and players can also continuously challenge their own limits.



At the same time, the difficulty unlocking of the second profession was adjusted to the difficulty unlocking of customs clearance 2 (human common mode);



The following is the description of each difficulty:



Difficulty 1:

The difficulty provided for budding players.

1. There are only two short chapters of maps, and each chapter has a fixed BOSS

2. Novice players understand the game mechanism and can choose their own personality genre at the beginning.



Difficulty 2:

1. Provide the complete play method of basic difficulty and fix the second BOSS in each chapter.

2. Removed the self-selected character genre at the beginning and added the character test plot.



Difficulty 3

This level is difficult for novices.

1. The monster's value and life are strengthened on [Normal] difficulty.

2. Two types of BOSS are provided in each chapter.



Difficulty 4

1. In the human [medium] difficulty mode, increase the monster's HP.

2. At the same time, three kinds of BOSS are provided for each piece.



Difficulty 5

1. In the human [difficult] difficulty mode, improve the monster attack



Difficulty 6

1. Reduce the revenue of battle scenario with elite/BOSS;

2. Go to the next chapter to restore HP and only increase 60 points of HP“



Difficulty 7

1. In the human [Nightmare] difficulty mode, increase the monster's HP



Difficulty 8

1. In Shura [Beginner] difficulty mode, increase monster attack



Difficulty 9

1. Reduce the character's maximum life by 15 points at the beginning



Difficulty 10

1. In Shura [Medium] difficulty mode, increase the monster's HP



Difficulty 11

1. In Shura [Difficult] difficulty mode, increase monster attack



Difficulty 12

1. Reduce the revenue of battle scenario with elite/BOSS;

2. Go to the next chapter to restore HP and only increase 40 points of HP



Difficulty 13

1. In the purgatory [entry] difficulty mode, increase the monster's HP



Difficulty 14

1. In Purgatory [Normal] difficulty mode, increase monster attack



Difficulty 15

1. In the purgatory [difficulty] difficulty mode, increase the monster's HP and attack




2、 Balance adjustment&bug fix:

1. The probability value of gaining weight of some cards has been readjusted;

2. Adjust the [Rage+] card: from the initial rage+3, this card will add an additional point of anger for each time it is played in this battle - it will be modified to: initial rage+2, each time it is played, an additional point of anger will be added;

3. Adjust the quality of [Tumbling] to a rare quality, and adjust multiple problems that can be obtained repeatedly;

4. Adjust [Bag Technique+] to increase mana consumption from 0 to 1;

5. Adjust the [Golden Wheel] from 3 * 3 damage to 2 * 2;

6. Adjust the [Golden Wheel+] from the original 3 * 4 damage to 2 * 3;

7. Adjust [Hunyuan Staff Technique] to cause 18 points of damage. If there is energy/anger attached, double the energy - change the energy to obtain 6 blocks

8. Adjust [Hunyuan Staff Technique+] to cause 27 points of damage. If there is energy/anger attached, double the energy - change the energy to obtain 9 blocks

9. When the character reaches 100/150/200, the character test and the character can't match the bug problem;

If you have more game experience or bug problems, you can join the exchange group of "Demon Subdue": 879319038

notes.title: 调整游戏强度及新增引导内容
notes.content:
游戏内目前还存在很多不足之处，同时也收到了很多玩家的反馈。首先感谢每个支持我们，以及给我们提出建议优化的伏魔师。本周我们也是加班加点的处理了新手引导，以及游戏内各种卡牌buff描述及关卡难度调整等内容。同时我们也正在准备关卡难度进阶玩法，感谢大家的一直以来的支持。

[h1]本期版本更新内容：[/h1]
[olist]
[*] 新增新手引导；
[*] 新增卡牌buff说明，放置在卡牌上，若卡牌附带buff将增加buff说明；
[*] 修复多次随机攻击目标时，如果目标死亡后终止攻击问题；
[*] 修复修罗斩斩杀后不增加生命上限问题；
[*] 主页上增加QQ跳转连接入口，欢迎加入群内讨论游戏内容；
[*] 修复每一章节BOSS不随机问题；
[*] 优化铁壁功卡牌图标；
[*] 修复繁体数值显示异常问题；
[*] 修复黑狗血、苗疆骨笛等若干个法宝buff显示异常问题；
[*] 修复个别怒气buff整场战斗和单回合叠加问题；
[/olist]
 
[h1]数值调整：[/h1]
[olist]
[*] 调整整体关卡怪物难度；
[*] 降低圣心流卡牌，圣心诀·龟的法力消耗从2降低为1点；
[*] 调整一阳指法力值消耗，从1点提升为2点；
[/olist]
